bounded_question: Which, if any, color-role relationship mechanism is worth carrying into later Kymaean integration while symbol, bespoke type, material, imagery, motion and semantic-status colors remain excluded?

controlled_inputs.matrix: 24 cells: CNEG, CCONV, F1, F2, F3, F4 across APP/WEB and WIDE/REFLOW_320

local_result.summary: Corrected structural/accessibility preflight is clean. Design Sol's valid pre-Director view recommends F2, retains F1 with a genericity reservation, and does not recommend F3/F4. Director taste/product-meaning adjudication is still genuinely open.
survivors_or_closure: F1 — provisional survivor with genericity reservation

judgment.design_sol_view: F2 is strongest because identity arises from broad low-chroma coherence plus a scarce contrasting intruder rather than from one conventional brand hue. F1 remains viable but carries premium-editorial/warm-earth genericity pressure.

mechanical: 320px horizontal reflow PASS with visible vertical carrier overflow
visual: six corrected normal PNG family sheets
six true forced-colors PNG family sheets
accessibility: color is not the sole carrier of meaning

requires: Director + Design Sol adjudication before a provisional CLR-01 mechanism is promoted

known_integration_sensitivities: F2's scarce accent must remain scarce once typography, icons, controls, imagery and motion are added; otherwise the mechanism collapses into ordinary brand-color saturation.
F2's accent must not accidentally become the universal selected/success/active state color without separate semantic-state work.
F1 may become more or less generic once final material/typography choices exist; any later change must be handled as integration evidence, not by rewriting this packet.
Color plus F1A/CS2 motion must be audited together so animated emphasis does not fabricate priority, progress or causal state.
explicit_non_authority: No final palette, production color token, semantic status-color system, app/site theme, implementation, final identity or Phase-C convergence is authorized.
The fixture hex values are experiment values and do not become production colors by surviving CLR-01.
lawful_reentry_triggers: later integration evidence after a provisional survivor is selected
